title: Engineer II, Software Quality Assurance
description:
**Additional Locations:** N/A

**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

**Software Quality Assurance Engineer II**

**About the role**

The Software Quality Assurance (SWQA) Engineer II provides quality and compliance support for medical device software development programs. This role partners with cross-functional teams to ensure software products are developed, verified, validated, and maintained in accordance with company procedures, regulatory requirements, and industry standards. Responsibilities include software design controls, risk management, verification and validation reviews, change assessments, and quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide Quality Assurance support for software development and sustaining engineering projects.
* Review software lifecycle deliverables including requirements, design documentation, traceability artifacts, verification and validation protocols/reports, and release documentation.
* Participate in software risk management activities, including hazard analysis, risk assessments, and verification of risk controls.
* Review software verification and validation activities to ensure appropriate coverage, traceability, and objective evidence.
* Support Software Change Assessments (SCA), impact assessments, CAPA, remediation, and post-market quality activities.
* Partner with R&D, Systems Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Program teams to ensure compliance with software design control requirements.
* Support compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and FDA QSR.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and support audit readiness activities.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 3+ years of experience in Software Quality, Software Development, Software Verification & Validation, or related engineering function.
* Knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in a regulated industry such as Medical Devices, Healthcare, Aerospace, or Automotive.
* Knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and FDA Design Controls.
* Experience with software design controls, risk management, and software validation.
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and lifecycle management tools such as Windchill, Jira.
* Exposure to cybersecurity, CAPA, remediation, or post-market quality activities.

**Requisition ID:** 635987

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. Learn more at www.bostonscientific.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Global IT Quality Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

The People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest and most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable global technology for BCG’s People Function, including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility & Career Development); L&D; and Core HR (including Workday, Compensation and Benefits).

We are seeking a **Global Quality Engineer Manager** to lead quality engineering execution for our **Vendor Management System (VMS)** products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of enterprise SaaS applications through effective manual and automated testing.

**You will:**

* Lead and mentor quality engineers across manual and automated testing, providing technical guidance, coaching, and quality oversight.
* Develop and execute test strategies for the VMS product/platform, aligned with established quality engineering standards.
* Remain hands-on with test automation, contributing to framework development, implementation, and code reviews.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve test coverage, efficiency, reliability, and release confidence.
* Ensure comprehensive testing of VMS workflows, business rules, APIs, integrations, databases, and backend services.
* Partner with product owners, business analysts, and engineers to translate requirements into effective test scenarios, including negative, boundary, integration, and edge cases.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into **CI/CD pipelines** and enable continuous testing.
* Lead defect triage and root cause analysis for complex or recurring issues and work with engineering teams on preventive actions.
* Track and report quality metrics, including defect trends, test coverage, automation coverage, and defect leakage, to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Provide quality assessments and recommendations to support release readiness and release decisions.
* Recommend and adopt appropriate testing tools and technologies to improve quality engineering effectiveness.
* Drive adoption of established QA practices and foster a **quality-first culture** within the VMS team.

What You'll Bring

**Required Experience:**

* **8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering**, with expertise in both manual and automation testing.
* Experience leading or technically guiding QA/Quality Engineering teams and mentoring engineers.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
* Experience testing **SaaS-based enterprise products,** preferably multi-tenant and cloud-native applications.
* Experience testing workflow-driven enterprise platforms such as **Vendor Management, Procurement, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), HR, or similar business applications**.
* Experience across functional, integration, regression, API, UI, end-to-end, and data validation testing.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, backend services, and enterprise system integrations.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum environments** with globally distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience testing SaaS-based **Vendor Management or Procurement platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Coupa, or similar enterprise workflow applications.**
* Experience with performance and load testing.
* Exposure to **AI-enabled testing tools or applications of AI within Quality Engineering.**

**Key Skills**

* Strong understanding of **QA methodologies, SDLC, STLC, Agile testing practices, and Quality Engineering principles**.
* Hands-on expertise with **Playwright (preferred) or Selenium**.
* Experience with automation approaches such as **Page Object Model (POM), Hybrid, and Data-Driven frameworks.**
* Proficiency in **Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python** for automation scripting.
* Experience with **API testing using Postman**; knowledge of **REST Assured** or similar frameworks is an advantage.
* Experience with test and defect management tools such as **JIRA, Zephyr, and QMetry**.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.**
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and workflow-driven systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll work with a globally distributed, cross-functional team of **product owners, business analysts, software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, quality engineers, and business stakeholders** in a fast-paced Agile environment.

As a hands-on technical quality leader, you will mentor quality engineers and partner with product and engineering teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle

Additional info

**You’re Good At:**

**Technical Leadership**

* Providing clear technical direction while remaining hands-on when needed.
* Coaching and developing quality engineers.
* Raising engineering standards through constructive reviews and knowledge sharing.

**Problem Solving & Decision Making**

* Anticipating risks and identifying issues early.
* Making pragmatic, risk-based decisions while balancing quality, timelines, and business priorities.
* Navigating complex technical and business problems with sound judgment.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Influencing teams and building alignment across functions and geographies.
* Giving and receiving constructive feedback effectively.

**Work Management & Organization**

* Managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Demonstrating strong attention to detail while maintaining focus on broader outcomes.
* Taking ownership and driving work through to completion.

**Customer & Business Focus**

* Understanding business workflows and the impact of product quality on users.
* Balancing technical quality with business needs and user experience.
* Maintaining a strong focus on reliable and scalable product outcomes.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Challenging existing ways of working and identifying practical opportunities for improvement.
* Staying current with evolving quality engineering technologies and practices.
* Promoting learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the team.

**Values & Ethics**

* Demonstrating accountability, sound judgment, and integrity.
* Handling confidential business and user information appropriately.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: QA Engineer (Testing)
description:
**About us:**

1Lattice is a 360-degree market intelligence platform with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a QA Engineer who can test modern web applications as well as AI-powered products, agents, and workflows. The role requires strong functional testing skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use AI tools to improve testing speed, coverage, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Test web applications across frontend, backend, APIs, and user workflows.

* Create clear test cases, test scenarios, bug reports, and QA checklists.

* Test AI agents, AI skills, prompts, workflows, and model-generated outputs.

* Validate AI responses for accuracy, consistency, edge cases, hallucinations, and user intent handling.

* Use AI tools to generate test cases, improve coverage, and speed up regression testing.

* Support automation of repetitive test cases using suitable tools or AI-assisted testing methods.

* Perform API testing, integration testing, regression testing, and basic performance checks.

* Work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ensure high-quality releases.

* Identify gaps in requirements, user journeys, and edge cases before development release.

**Must Have Skills**

* 1–3 years of experience in manual and/or automation testing.

* Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, bug lifecycle, test planning, and regression testing.

* Hands-on experience testing web applications and APIs.

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or similar tools for QA work.

* Understanding of prompt testing, AI agent testing, or LLM-based application testing.

* Familiarity with tools like Postman, Swagger, Jira, GitHub, or similar tools.

* Basic understanding of automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.

* Ability to write structured test cases and clear bug reports.

* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

**Good to Have**

* Basic scripting knowledge in JavaScript or Python.

* Exposure to test automation frameworks.

* Experience testing dashboards, data-heavy platforms, or workflow-based applications.

* Understanding of test data creation, edge-case testing, and regression planning.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Curious about AI and modern QA practices.

* Can think beyond standard happy-path testing.

* Comfortable testing both regular software and AI-driven behaviour.

* Can use AI tools intelligently to improve productivity, not just generate generic test cases.

* Takes ownership of product quality and communicates issues clearly.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on modern web platforms, AI-enabled products, and internal automation tools.

* Learn how to test AI agents, AI workflows, and data-driven applications.

* Be part of a growing tech team building products for enterprise

title: Sr. QA Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
---------------


A leading independent academic publishing company is seeking a Sr. QA Analyst to ensure the quality and reliability of its business systems. The ideal candidate will meticulously test and analyse our software applications to maintain the highest standards of performance and functionality.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**
------------------------


The job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Own test strategy for features and cross\-system initiatives, defining scope, approach, coverage, dependencies, and test requirements.
* Apply risk\-based testing to identify critical scenarios, regression scope, and integration risks, and determine what should be tested, deferred, or excluded based on requirements and business impact.
* Understand end\-to\-end system flows and integrations, including upstream/downstream impacts, APIs, data flows, and system dependencies.
* Define and review high\-level test scenarios for complex features and integrated products, ensuring coverage of key functional, negative, boundary, and business\-risk scenarios.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Engineers from the requirements stage to understand business and technical requirements, identify gaps, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the lifecycle.
* Test complex features, integrations, and bug fixes using appropriate manual and technical testing techniques, including API and database testing, and investigate defects to identify root causes.
* Drive test automation by identifying suitable automation opportunities and independently developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts in collaboration with automation engineers.
* Assess test results and quality risks, provide input on release readiness, and proactively communicate issues that may impact quality, timelines, or business outcomes.
* Mentor and guide QA team members on requirements, test strategy, scenario design, integrations, and troubleshooting, and review their test coverage where needed.
* Represent the QA team in cross\-functional discussions, clearly communicating testing status, risks, dependencies, and priorities, while maintaining strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and other QA teams.
* Coordinate integration testing for integrated products, working across teams to manage dependencies, test data, environments, and testing timelines.
* Contribute to improving automation coverage, QA practices, and test processes, including CI/CD integration where applicable.
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and QA process improvements, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies and team activities.
* Demonstrate ownership, curiosity, and sound judgment by proactively exploring system behaviour and business flows, raising risks early, and making informed testing decisions with minimal supervision.

**Skills, Qualifications \& Experience**
----------------------------------------

**Technical Skills**

* **Manual \& Regression Testing:** Strong experience testing complex features and integrated systems, with a focus on regression coverage and system dependencies.
* **Automation:** Hands\-on experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, with an eagerness to quickly learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies. Experience identifying automation opportunities and improving automation coverage.
* **Test Strategy \& Risk\-Based Testing:** Ability to develop test strategies, define test scope, identify critical scenarios, and make risk\-based decisions on test coverage.
* **Integration \& System Knowledge:** Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business flows, system integrations, APIs, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* **Requirements \& Testability Analysis:** Ability to analyse business and technical requirements, identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the development lifecycle.
* **Technical Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis:** Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems, using logs, data, and system behaviour to identify root causes.
* **Test Management \& Defect Tracking:** Experienced in test case/scenario design, execution, defect investigation, tracking, and resolution.
* **API \& Database Testing:** Hands\-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman/SoapUI) and SQL/database validation; basic understanding of performance testing.
* **Agile:** Experience working in Agile teams and actively participating in planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant ceremonies.
* **QA Process Improvement:** Contributes to QA standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **GenAI:** Experience using GenAI tools to improve QA efficiency, test design, analysis, and productivity.

**Soft Skills**

* **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**: Works effectively with Product Owners, Engineers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and risks.
* **Communication**: Clearly communicates technical information, testing status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Confidently communicates QA perspectives, challenges assumptions constructively, and influences technical and business decisions based on quality, risk, and customer impact.
* **Curiosity \& Continuous Learning**: Proactively explores systems, integrations, business processes, and new technologies to deepen understanding and identify potential risks.
* **Mentorship**: Guides QA team members on requirements, test scenarios, integrations, testing approaches, and troubleshooting.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Decision\-Making**: Uses critical thinking, technical analysis, and risk assessment to identify issues and make sound testing decisions.
* **Ownership \& Accountability**: Dependable in delivering commitments, proactively raises risks and blockers, and follows through on responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* **Adaptability**: Responds effectively to changing requirements, priorities, and business needs.
* **Team Representation**: Represents the QA team effectively in cross\-functional discussions and ensures QA perspectives, risks, and priorities are clearly communicated.
* **Professional Maturity**: Demonstrates sound judgment, emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to balance technical, business, and team priorities.

**Work Requirements**

* **Availability:** Willing and available to work UK business hours.

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**


At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.

title: Quality Analyst-(ATPL-quality-analyst-2026/09/1008)
description:

**Position Title** Quality Analyst **Business Unit / Function** Information Technology
  

**Functional Reporting to: (Please provide position title)** QA Lead **Department** Information Technology
  

**Responsibilities:**


* Design, write, and execute detailed manual test cases, test plans, and scripts based on business and technical requirements.
* Perform functional, regression, UAT, and acceptance testing for web and mobile applications.
* Conduct Web Services/API testing using Postman or Swagger.
* Lead/contribute in design, creation, and adoption of automation frameworks, guiding the automation team on best practices(preferred lang Java, python).
* Conduct web automation testing using tools such as Selenium, Protractor, or equivalent.
* Perform database validations using SQL queries and scripts.
* Execute performance testing to assess system behaviour under load conditions.
* Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including test strategies, risk assessments, and test result reports.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to ensure the application functions meet business needs.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Review system requirements and technical design documents for testability and completeness.
* Mentor junior QA team members and review their deliverables to ensure high\-quality output aligned with established testing frameworks.
* Lead QA\-related communication with business owners and stakeholders, providing test updates, risk analysis, and timelines.

**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in manual software testing, with additional hands\-on automation experience.
* Strong proficiency in test scenario design, test case creation, and test execution.
* Expertise in API testing, SQL/database validation, and performance testing tools.
* Familiarity with test management and bug tracking tools such as JIRA and TestRail.
* Solid experience in designing and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
